item.title: jamellebouie.net: the *historical* explanations for racial inequality are so straightforward and w
item.description:
the *historical* explanations for racial inequality are so straightforward and well-documented that the only reason someone would reach for a biological explanation is IMHO that they a priori believe in natural human hierarchies (and typically see themselves as being at the top of the ladder).
[contains quote post or other embedded content]
Quoting @victorerikray.bsky.social: A group of “scientists” in my field are zealously attempting to make eugenics respectable again, and this is the basic logic of their claim.
Yes, biological explanations for racial inequality may be racist, but we should nonetheless take them seriously.

just to build on this, if the fundamental premise of your worldview is false — and if you the interlocutor grant that it is false — then why would you trust this person’s ability to reason and draw conclusions that correspond to reality?
